counts: named unsigned 64-bit integers; header order retained; expected list validates exact set; trailing and entirely omitted cost counters are zero
domain: ASCII v1 single-part complete whole-program line-only dump; no thread splits, derived events, jump records, or instruction positions. Full summary and totals vectors required; exact SELF=summary=totals for every event. General Callgrind partial summaries need not obey this stronger workflow condition.
attribution: coalesced object/function-NAME totals and file partitions, not unique physical function ownership; raw row numbers/text, name tokens and literal source/object/callee context retained; inherited callee objects explicitly unresolved
rates: Bcm/Bc and Bim/Bi only, null with absent/zero denominator; not hardware rates/cycles/weighted cost
no_import_side_effects: definitions/imports only; CLI writes only when explicitly invoked; no subprocess in parser
